lia (sec-eng): Quick heads-up — Audit job detected anomalous admin bindings for 3 KMS keys in staging. Also a few roles with no owner. Kicking off a short "access spiral" to tighten and verify. @maria @kevin please hold role changes for next 2h :rotating_light:
kevin (infra): on it. posting the raw query results here shortly. can we freeze terraform applies to staging for the window?
maria (sre): freezing CI deploys to staging for 60m. will revert after manual OK.
oliver (platform): FYI we have a canary that needs write access to one of those keys — i'll check whether it's using service account with cross-proj binding.
devon (product-security): thanks. can someone paste the KMS diff and the list of ownerless roles? i want to attach to the evidence bundle.
lia (sec-eng): here's the gcloud snippet i ran:
```
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --project=redwood-staging \--format=json \--filter="rotationPeriod: != null AND iamBindings.admin: true"
```
outputs: key-enc-3, creds-temp, ci-canary-key  (three hits)
kevin (infra): raw binding json (trimmed): 
```
"bindings": [
  { "role": "roles/cloudkms.admin", "members": ["serviceAccount:canary@redwood-svc.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "user:external-contractor@example.com"] }
]
```
maria (sre): external-contractor is unexpected — we should revoke until we validate. i'll create a temp ticket and mark P2.
devon (product-security): Agreed — revoke and request justification. If it's an external partner, we need an approved access doc + expiry.
lia (sec-eng): proposed short plan:
1) revoke the unexpected members from the three keys (kevin)
2) snapshot current IAM + KMS audit logs (maria)
3) run ownerless-role report and map to teams (lia)
4) open attestation threads for the remaining admins (devon)
5) schedule rollback window and re-eval after 24h (oliver)
kevin (infra): revoking now for the external principal. running: 
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding key-enc-3 \--member="user:external-contractor@example.com" \--role=roles/cloudkms.admin --project=redwood-staging
```
kevin (infra): removed external principal from key-enc-3 :white_check_mark: will run for the other two next.
maria (sre): snapshotting logs to gs://sec-audit-dumps/staging/2704051234/ and exporting Cloud Audit logs for the last 90d. i'll preserve the export for the compliance pack.
lia (sec-eng): also flagging any service accounts with cross-project grants — remind the app teams to rotate keys if they were relying on the principal.
oliver (platform): can we get a quick script to list ownerless roles? i have a lot of directories to check.
lia (sec-eng): yeah, run this one-liner: 
```
python - <<'PY'
# ownerless role psuedo-run
# (replace with infra tooling; this is quick check)
import json,subprocess
r = subprocess.check_output(['gcloud','iam','roles','list','--project=redwood-staging','--format=json'])
roles = json.loads(r)
print([r['name'] for r in roles if not r.get('stage') or 'owner' not in r.get('description','')])
PY
```
devon (product-security): i'll start attestation messages to the listed owners. for roles with no owner we'll tag infra and product leads for assignment.
maria (sre): FYI sre-bot posted an automated alert: "config drift detected: key-enc-3 binding changed outside terraform" — linking: https://alerts.redwood/s/ABCD1234
kevin (infra): terraform drift makes sense — something was patched via console last week. i'll add an import step and a backlog ticket to reconcile.
lia (sec-eng): action owners summarized:
- revoke unexpected members: kevin
- logs + snapshot: maria
- ownerless mapping: lia
- attestation threads: devon
- reconcile infra drift + import to IaC: oliver
kevin (infra): started revoke for creds-temp and ci-canary-key now. ETA ~6 minutes.
maria (sre): snapshot complete and zipped to gs://sec-audit-dumps/staging/2704051234/audit.zip :lock: 
lia (sec-eng): good. next steps after revokes:
- run smoke tests for canary functionality (oliver)
- reopen role edits after attestation and reconcilation (lia)
- update runbook with a short checklist for cross-project KMS owners (devon)

devon (product-security): i'll draft runbook snippet and post PR to docs in ~30m. tagging compliance for review.
oliver (platform): smoke test passed for canary using alternate key (we pointed it to a scoped service account) :thumbsup:
kevin (infra): revokes done for all three keys :white_check_mark: had two terraform imports queued, creating tickets: INFRA-1129, INFRA-1130
maria (sre): re-enabled CI deploy freeze window expiration — forgot to mention i'll watch for errors for the next 2 deploys.
lia (sec-eng): nice work team. i'll file a short incident summary for the security committee and mark this as "access-spiral: closed" after we get attestation proofs. if anything else pops up post-recon, ping this thread. :handshake:

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2027KMS. Linked artifacts: gs://sec-audit-dumps/staging/2704051234/audit.zip, INFRA-1129, INFRA-1130
kevin (infra): leaving follow-up tasks in the infra board. thanks everyone.
devon (product-security): follow-ups: add expiration enforcement for external principal grants, and add a CI gating policy to prevent console-level admin grants in staging. i'll include both in the runbook PR.
lia (sec-eng): closing window. last check in 10m. :lock:
kevin (infra): 10m passed, no regressions. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
